name: log-card-read
description: Structured log, the card-read probe: at the first flush of a session (the GUI enters a menu, playback or the power-off state) the flush task opens C:\EPM2LOOK.BIN with mode r, reads its first 16 bytes with fileif_fread (0x7E5C536F), closes it, and writes the event card_read (bytes read, -1 when the file did not open; bytes 0-3 of the file). Then the flush runs as before. One hook at the flush task's entry (log-core's code, not stock) and its routine after the flush task. Needs the specs of data/builds/debug-log-films-12d.json before it: every expect is a byte string of that build. It puts the build id 3cc5e33e95b6de52 of data/logdict/events.json into the block header. DEBUG builds only. See experiments/2026-11-17-card-looks/NOTES.md and docs/reference/logging.md.
_ram: 1 byte of the log's state block (PST+104); the flush task's block buffer for the read

ops._note: hook (card_read): jmp T_CRD. the flush task's entry (log-core): `movm [d2,d3,a2,a3],(sp)` / `add -64,sp`; task USRTEST_A, started by T_GUI when the GUI enters a menu, playback or the power-off state
flush task, block header: build id bytes 0-3 da49b2f5 -> 3cc5e33e (data/logdict/events.json)
flush task, block header: build id bytes 4-7 e7e62ca7 -> 95b6de52 (data/logdict/events.json)
